en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large outdoor banquet or garden party. Numerous well‑dressed men and women in early 20th‑century attire sit at long tables covered with white tablecloths on a grassy lawn. Most men wear suits and straw boaters or felt hats; women wear cloche‑style hats. In the background stands a small domed observatory building surrounded by trees and more guests. The scene suggests a formal gathering near an astronomical observatory.
